questions.statement: In which class do you add and subtract numbers?
questions.context: En una escuela de Popayán, los niños suman y restan números en el tablero.

options.feedback: Incorrect. In Art you paint and draw pictures, not add numbers.
Correct. Math is the class of numbers, where you add and subtract.
Incorrect. In Music you sing and play instruments, not subtract numbers.
Incorrect. In Spanish class you read and write in Spanish, not do sums.

questions.explanation: "Math" es la clase de matemáticas, donde sumamos ("add") y restamos ("subtract"). "Art" es artes, "Music" es música y "Spanish" es la clase de español.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: In which class do you sing songs and play the drums?
questions.context: En un colegio de Santa Marta, los estudiantes cantan y tocan tambores para el día de la familia.

options.feedback: Incorrect. In Science you study plants, animals and experiments, not songs.
Incorrect. P.E. means Physical Education: you run and play games, not play drums.
Correct. Music is the class where you sing songs and play instruments like drums.
Incorrect. Math is about numbers, and drums are musical instruments.

questions.explanation: "Music" es la clase de música. Allí cantamos canciones ("sing songs") y tocamos instrumentos como el tambor ("drums"). "P.E." es educación física y "Science" es ciencias.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "I paint and draw pictures. My favorite subject is ____."
questions.context: Isabella vive en Cartago y en clase pinta flores y dibuja paisajes con colores.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Science is about nature and experiments; painting pictures belongs to another class.
Incorrect. English is the class where you learn words in English, not paint.
Incorrect. Social Studies is about cities, maps and people, not drawing pictures.
Correct. In Art class you paint and draw, so Art is the subject that matches.

questions.explanation: La frase "My favorite subject is..." significa "Mi materia favorita es...". Si la niña pinta y dibuja ("paint and draw"), su materia favorita es "Art", la clase de artes.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Pedro: "What is your favorite subject?"
Luisa: "____"
questions.context: Pedro y Luisa son compañeros en un colegio de Armenia y conversan en el descanso.

options.feedback: Correct. Pedro asks about a subject, and Science is a school subject.
Incorrect. Blue is a color, but Pedro asks about a school subject.
Incorrect. A pencil is a school object, not a subject or class.
Incorrect. Monday is a day of the week, and the question asks for a subject.

questions.explanation: "What is your favorite subject?" pregunta por tu materia favorita. La respuesta debe nombrar una materia, como "Science" (ciencias). Un color, un objeto o un día no responden la pregunta.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "Valentina studies plants and animals in class. Today she looks at a leaf and a small bug."
What class is it?
questions.context: Valentina estudia en Florencia, Caquetá, cerca de la selva, y observa plantas y animales en clase.

options.feedback: Incorrect. In Spanish class you read stories; studying a leaf and a bug is not the topic.
Correct. Science is the class where you study plants, animals and nature.
Incorrect. In P.E. you move your body and play sports, not study a leaf.
Incorrect. In Music you sing and play instruments, not look at bugs.

questions.explanation: Si en la clase se estudian plantas ("plants") y animales ("animals"), es la clase de ciencias: "Science". La hoja ("leaf") y el insecto ("bug") son pistas de la naturaleza.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: En un colegio de Cúcuta, la clase de educación física es en la cancha del colegio.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Reading stories in Spanish is what you do in Spanish class.
Incorrect. Drawing a map of Colombia belongs to Social Studies.
Incorrect. Counting numbers is an activity of Math class.
Correct. P.E. is Physical Education, and in it you run and play games.

questions.explanation: "P.E." significa "Physical Education", es decir, educación física. En esta clase corremos ("run") y jugamos ("play games"). Leer cuentos, dibujar mapas y contar pertenecen a otras materias.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read Juan's schedule:
Monday: Math and English
Tuesday: Art and Music
Wednesday: P.E. and Science
Juan wants to take his paints to school. Which day should he take them?
questions.context: Juan estudia en Pasto y mira su horario para saber qué llevar al colegio cada día.

options.feedback: Incorrect. On Monday Juan has Math and English, and there is no Art class that day.
Incorrect. On Wednesday Juan has P.E. and Science, so he does not need paints.
Correct. Paints are for Art class, and Juan has Art on Tuesday.
Incorrect. Friday is not on Juan's schedule, so we do not know about Art that day.

questions.explanation: Las pinturas ("paints") se usan en la clase de artes ("Art"). En el horario, "Art" aparece el martes ("Tuesday"). Por eso Juan debe llevar las pinturas ese día.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Sara says: "I like learning about the cities, rivers and people of Colombia."
Which subject is best for her?
questions.context: Sara vive en Leticia y le encanta aprender sobre los ríos, las ciudades y la gente de Colombia.

options.feedback: Correct. Social Studies teaches about cities, rivers, maps and people of a country.
Incorrect. Math is about numbers and shapes, not the cities and people of Colombia.
Incorrect. English teaches a language; cities and rivers are the topic of another subject.
Incorrect. P.E. is about exercise and sports, not learning about Colombia's rivers.

questions.explanation: "Social Studies" es la clase de ciencias sociales: allí aprendemos sobre ciudades ("cities"), ríos ("rivers") y personas ("people"). Por eso es la mejor materia para Sara.
questions.subject: ingles
